# Shop

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 6 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Shopify consumer shopping chrome: near-white page, left icon rail, frosted search, purple pill Continue, 20px product tiles.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (signup wall opened and not submitted). Themes: light.

Shop is Shopify's consumer shopping app. This package records the public signed-out home at https://shop.com/ and the signup wall at https://shop.app/accounts/login, measured on 2026-11-19 from a live T3 preview tab. https://shop.app/ follows redirects to https://shop.com/ for the public home. No account was created. The email field was not filled. Continue was not submitted. No card, phone or checkout was entered.

The live CSS viewport was 1169 by 731 at devicePixelRatio 2. Both pages computed light backgrounds. `prefers-color-scheme: dark` matched, and the pages did not switch.

## Typography

9 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: GT Standard Web, GTStandard-M.

### Fonts (from README.md)

GT Standard Web is the home face, computed on `body` and declared as `--default-font-family`. `document.fonts` reported GT Standard Web 300 900 loaded. The login page computes `GTStandard-M` ahead of `ui-sans-serif`. The mono stack is `ui-monospace`. These families are named as computed. The font files are not in this package.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The CSS viewport was 1169, not 1440 and not 390. Do not treat these readings as a 1440 or 390 capture. `prefers-color-scheme: dark` was true and both pages stayed light. There is no dark token set. Login primary hover is a declared custom property, `--buttons--primary-background-hover` (`rgb(127, 104, 233)`), and the hover was not shown. Home body background computed as `oklch(0.98809 0 0)`. The page token uses the declared `--bg` (`#fcfcfc`). Rail icon colours stayed in oklch in [components.md](components.md) and were not converted. The catalog cover is the site icon, not a page capture.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the near-white page and black text.** Home renders on `#fcfcfc` with `#000000` text and `#0000008f` tertiary text. [patterns.md](patterns.md) describes that shell.
- **Use the purple pill for the primary action.** Continue is white text on `#5433eb`, 52px tall, radius 999px. [components.md](components.md) lists the size.
- **Keep the signup wall as a gap.** https://shop.app/accounts/login asks for an email, then Continue or a passkey. A signed-in feed and a checkout stay out of this package. [components.md](components.md) records the gap.
- **Use GT Standard Web at 64px for the hero and 16px for body.** The hero is weight 800, line-height 58px, letter-spacing -1px. [tokens.json](tokens.json) keeps that style.
- **Leave screenshots empty when frames fail.** The preview browser produced no frames. [screenshots/](screenshots/) says so.
